page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g9a.8xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs based on the x86_64 architecture, utilizing AMD EPYC 9T25 processors running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage volumes for operating system and application data. It also lacks integrated GPU accelerators, making it unsuitable for hardware-accelerated graphics or deep learning workloads. For connectivity, the instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps, and it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The ecs.g9a.8xlarge offers a balanced resource density suitable for workloads requiring a steady ratio of compute to memory. Its dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention. This profile is appropriate for general-purpose enterprise applications, web serving, application servers, medium-sized databases, and containerized microservices.
